summary: Expose human gates when steps become ready and fail native waits when asks are cancelled

replay.detail: Native ask cancellation projects failure only onto the exact waiting ask and origin attempt. Historical automatic cancellations without an explicit episode use their direct asking-claim predecessor; explicit mismatching episodes remain refused. Replayed stale cancellation effects cannot fail a newer attempt or a different asking episode; program journals retain their meaning.

compatibility.detail: Step human gates open before a worker claims or submits work, in declaration order so same-reviewer questions remain answerable. Cancelling a native person ask fails its exact waiting step attempt with the cancelling actor in the reason; ordinary failure and finally handling follows. Programs retain the typed AskCancelled failure, which can be handled or propagated.

downtime.detail: No downtime beyond the ordinary daemon restart.

manual.detail: Ready steps request human review automatically on reconciliation; no worker claim is needed.

recovery.detail: Revert the runtime change to restore prior behavior; no stored-data migration is required.
